==Fried Amphibian Legs==

Using the {{i|Fried Frog Legs}} recipe and the appropriate amphibian legs will create fried amphibian legs. Fried Frog Legs must be cooked with a {{i|Frying Pan}} equipped and over a source of {{i|Fire}} such as a lit {{i|Fireplace}} or {{i|Pile of Wood}}. Cooking things over a Fire lowers your [[Insanity]] a little and has a chance to give you a {{i|Gelatinous Lard}}.
